en:
It seems Maki has been standing guard in
front of her research lab this whole time.

Does that mean I need to deliver dinner
to her?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kirumi for a while?

She cannot enjoy her meal while standing,
so I need to bring a table set as well.
...Perhaps I can find one in the warehouse.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi and I spent some time
searching the warehouse...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi and I grew a little closer today.
